prompt: Implement the approved Verrail G1 brand and navigation foundation end to end, preserve compatibility identifiers, and leave inspectable evidence.
allowed_actions: Create brand source and raster assets
Change company compatibility schema and synchronized contracts
Add route and plugin conflict protections
Add focused tests and generate a database migration
Create or update canonical Verrail documentation
forbidden_actions: Rename authentication, telemetry, package, CLI, database, or environment identifiers
Enable the new navigation for existing workspaces
Ship or merge without explicit user approval
expected_evidence: Brand asset manifest and rendered contact sheet
Focused route, validator, conflict, schema, and UI helper tests
Typecheck, test, build, and integrity command results
stop_conditions: The flag cannot be kept Workspace-scoped
An installed-plugin collision cannot be detected before activation
Validation failure requires weakening existing tests or contracts
